description: PIN entry with an optional randomised layout and haptic-only key feedback (SEC-090).

props.name: randomizeLayout
props.description: Shuffles the digit positions each time the pad appears.

props.name: haptics
props.description: Haptic feedback on key press; no visual key-press animation.

events.name: onCompleted
events.description: Fires with the PIN once `length` digits are entered. Sensitive: never logged, traced or persisted (SEC-092).
